wa_chair_peak_northeast_buttress.notes: S-shaped gully on climber's right; conditions vary from easy snow to mixed climbing; a left slab variation exists. Tree anchor.
Long pitch (70-80m) to the base of the ice bulge.
The route's crux - an obvious, steep ice bulge (or rock step when dry); awkward anchor placement above.
Leads to the summit saddle; many parties unrope for the final scrambling.

wa_city_park.notes: Pin-scarred splitter seam via bolt ladder; historically graded America's hardest crack until Todd Skinner freed it in 1986.
Thin stemming to crack and ledgy face climbing to ledge anchor (also separately cataloged as City Park P2).
Can be free climbed at moderate grade.
Can be free climbed at moderate grade; alternate finish via Tommy's Sandbox noted above P2 anchor.
